verdict.rationale: Codex cloud documents running tasks in parallel in isolated environments, and reviewing each result's summary and diff before opening a pull request. That covers the parallel-execution and per-result review parts of the story. However, nothing documents launching multiple attempts of the same task or comparing alternative results side by side before choosing one. missing for 10: documented multiple attempts per task (best-of-N), side-by-side comparison of attempts, selecting a winning attempt, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
